name: Botpass – MCP Server for ChatGPT, Claude & AI Search
author: botpass

sections.description:
AI assistants are becoming the new search engine. When someone asks ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini about a product, a service or a company, the assistant answers with whatever it can find – often an outdated page, a competitor or a guess.

Botpass gives your brand its own MCP server (Model Context Protocol, the open standard AI assistants use to connect to tools and data). The plugin keeps it fed with your WordPress content and your WooCommerce catalogue, so assistants get accurate, up-to-date answers straight from the source: you.

What the plugin does

  • Connects your site in minutes. Create a free Botpass account, add your site, paste the key. No code, no theme edits.
  • Syncs your content automatically. Pages, posts, public custom post types and WooCommerce products are sent when you publish, edit, unpublish or delete them.
  • Keeps your catalogue fresh. Prices, sale prices, SKUs and stock status reach AI assistants as soon as they change in WooCommerce.
  • Respects your SEO decisions. Drafts, private and password-protected content, and anything marked “noindex” in Yoast SEO, Rank Math or SEOPress is never sent.
  • Shows you what’s live. See your MCP server address, your setup checklist and the sync status right from the WordPress dashboard.
  • Lets you choose. Pick which content types are synced from the Content tab.

Why an MCP server?

Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) are not only about ranking pages. AI assistants increasingly call tools instead of reading web pages. A branded MCP server at mcp.botpass.io/your-brand lets them ask your brand directly – what you sell, what it costs, whether it’s in stock, how to get in touch – and answer with facts you approved.

Built to be light

  • Sends signed requests (HMAC-SHA256) to the Botpass API in small batches, in the background via WP-Cron.
  • No front-end scripts, no tracking pixels, no changes to your theme.
  • Works with page builders and block themes: content is sent as visitors see it.
  • Multilingual-aware: detects the language of each post with Polylang or WPML.
  • Includes Spanish translations (Spain and Latin America).

External service

This plugin connects to the Botpass API (https://api.botpass.io), a service provided by Botpass Labs, in order to:

  • validate your site key and the site linked to it;
  • send your published content (title, content, excerpt, categories, tags, language, URL and, for WooCommerce, price, SKU and stock status) whenever it changes;
  • send a daily count of published pages per content type;
  • show your MCP server status in the WordPress dashboard.

Nothing is sent until you connect the site with your key. No visitor, customer or order data is ever sent.

Terms of service: https://botpass.io/legal/terms
Privacy policy: https://botpass.io/legal/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install Botpass from Plugins → Add New (search for “Botpass”) and activate it.
  2. Create your free account at botpass.io and add your site (use your site’s domain).
  3. In the Botpass dashboard, open your site, generate the plugin key and copy it (it is shown only once).
  4. In WordPress, go to the Botpass menu, paste the key and click Connect.

Your content starts syncing straight away. The Overview tab shows your MCP server address once your brand profile is approved.
sections.faq:
What is MCP?

The Model Context Protocol is an open standard that lets AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini connect to external tools and data sources. Botpass hosts an MCP server for your brand and keeps it in sync with your site.

Do I need a Botpass account?

Yes. It’s free to create at botpass.io. The account is where you approve the information AI assistants can use about your brand.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. Products are synced with their price, sale price, SKU, categories and stock status, and updates are sent whenever a product or its stock changes. Hidden products are not sent.

Which content is sent?

Only published content from the content types you enable. Private, password-protected and “noindex” content (Yoast SEO, Rank Math, SEOPress) is always excluded. If you unpublish or delete something, it is removed from Botpass too.

Will it slow down my site?

No. Syncing runs in the background with WP-Cron, in small batches, and the plugin adds nothing to your public pages.

Is it compatible with page builders?

Yes. Content is rendered the way visitors see it, so Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder, Bricks and the block editor all work.

I updated from version 3.x. What do I need to do?

Version 4 is a new plugin built for Botpass 4. After updating, generate your site key in the Botpass dashboard and paste it into the plugin to reconnect.

How do I disconnect?

Go to Botpass → Overview → Disconnect. Content already sent stays in your Botpass account until you delete it there. Deleting the plugin removes all its settings from WordPress.

  • Daily page inventory and setup checklist in the dashboard.
